steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each step is placed on the grievance timeline against its procedure deadline.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 step is past its procedure deadline

findings.title: Step past its procedure deadline
findings.fix: Schedule the step now and tell the parties

findings.title: Outcome with no reason
findings.fix: Record the reason for the outcome

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] grv-0101.md:12  Step past its procedure deadline.
       Fix: Schedule the step now and tell the parties.
[medium] grv-0103.md:19  Grievance with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
[low] grv-0105.md:26  Outcome with no reason.
       Fix: Record the reason for the outcome.
Not checked: The merits of the grievance.
pros: Checks a step past its procedure deadline, a grievance with no owner, and an outcome with no reason.
cons: Not checked: The merits of the grievance.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hr-grievance-log skill on the records for this review.
